note:
stock/product_template.py: 285 -> 284, banking a fall that 1bf7b8a8b69 left unbanked.

That commit deleted a duplicated block in ProductTemplate, and the 285th field
hook was in it -- `_search_qty_available` and its three siblings were each
defined twice, and the shadowed copies counted. Removing them leaves one
definition per field, which is the number this gate is measuring.

An exact ratchet fails in the falling direction too, and this one did: the
commit that caused the fall did not carry the floor with it. Corrected here
rather than left, because a red gate nobody owns is exactly what §4 of the
workspace CLAUDE.md is about, and this one has an owner.
